root_cause.text: The xe_pagefault_service function failed to reject write/atomic access to read-only VMAs, allowing unauthorized modifications to read-only memory regions.
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds a check after VMA lookup: if `xe_vma_read_only(vma)` is true and the access type is not read (`XE_PAGEFAULT_ACCESS_TYPE_READ`), it returns `-EPERM`. The commit description explicitly states that "the page fault handler should reject write/atomic access to read only VMAs" and that this was missing.
